build_NeuralLinearBandit: build a NeuralLinearBandit policy learner with neural network features and linear regression for contextual bandit reward prediction
learn_batch_NeuralLinearBandit: train the NeuralLinearBandit model on a TransitionBatch by backpropagating through the neural network and updating linear regression
act_NeuralLinearBandit: select an action from a discrete action space using the NeuralLinearBandit exploration module given a subjective state
get_scores_NeuralLinearBandit: compute UCB scores for all actions in a discrete action space using the NeuralLinearBandit model
compare_NeuralLinearBandit: compare two NeuralLinearBandit instances for differences in attributes, model weights, and optimizer state
